sentences.text:
Shri C.S. Upadhyay - Panel Lawyer for the respondent-St
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.507/2024 registered at Police Station Shahjahanbad District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 305 of IPC and Section 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. According to the prosecution's version, on 11.09.2024, the mother of the prosecutrix lodged a missing report regarding her minor daughter, stating that she had been missing since that day.

Pursuant to the said report, the police registered a missing person NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:49623 2 MCRC-35898-2025 report thereafter, the the prosecutrix had recovered from the present applicant.
Thereafter the FIR has been lodged against the applicant.
2. Leaned counsel for the applicant contends the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

It is contended by the counsel that the statement of the mother (PW-1) and her uncle (PW-2) of the prosecutrix have been recorded before the trial Court and they did not depose anything against the applicant.
It is contended by the counsel that the applicant and prosecutrix were known to each other and the prosecutrix on her own volition went with the applicant.

It is contended by the counsel that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he is in custody since 15.02.2025, therefore, he deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3.

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the prayer and submitted that there are direct allegations against the applicant, therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out to the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

5. Considering the totality of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that applicant is in custody since 15.02.2025, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:49623 3 MCRC-35898-2025 6.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
